invite.donationTitle: Your old clothes, up the mountain.
invite.donationBody: Once a month we take sorted, wearable clothes to communities in the Northwest. Worn-out pieces become the recovered textile in our bags.

product.inspect: Cash on delivery · inspect before you pay

product.deliveryBody: Studio pickup is free. Shipping is 30,000 ₫ in Hanoi and 40,000 ₫ elsewhere in Vietnam. Fees appear at checkout.
product.paymentBody: Choose cash on delivery or bank transfer. Inspect the bag before paying on delivery.
product.returnsBody: Please contact us before returning or exchanging a bag so we can help with the next step.
product.careBody: Wipe coated canvas with a soft, slightly damp cloth. Contact us if handles, buckles or seams need repair.
product.questionsBody: What are the recovered parts made from? Recovered canvas with a matte coated finish. You can also try a bag at the studio.

craft.title: Designed to carry a working day.
craft.intro: A quiet exterior makes room for the woven details within.
craft.body: The body combines dense jacquard canvas or felt with recovered material at the handles, flaps, straps and scarf. The materials of every part are listed on each product page.

about.title: A working bag, with another story inside.
about.intro: Refvlks is a Hanoi work-bag brand shaped around the pace of city days. Tailored forms sit beside woven details, made to be noticed up close.

donation.title: Once a month, we take clothes to the mountains.
donation.intro: Bring us the clothes you no longer wear. We check every piece, take the wearable ones to communities in the Northwest and other mountain regions, and turn the rest into the recovered textile in our bags.
